title: LIVE | Vantage with Palki Sharma: Your New Destination for Global News with an Indian Perspective
summary: Vantage with Palki Sharma is a news, opinions, and current affairs show from Firstpost, offering a global audience a 360-degree perspective on major news stories through an Indian lens. Vantage airs Monday to Friday at 9 PM IST on Firstpost across all leading platforms.
